_comment: FROZEN FIXTURE. Every value here was produced by CALLING the Python desktop app's own coords/sizing/camera_state/pack_configs functions, back when that app existed. It has since been removed, so these are no longer regenerable -- and that is the point: they are an independent record of what the reference implementation computed, which is the only thing that can catch a symmetric error the port's own round-trip tests would cancel out. DO NOT recompute these from the TypeScript; that would turn them into a test of the port against itself.

sizing._roundingNote: Python's round() is half-to-EVEN; JavaScript's Math.round is half-up. They differ only when dim*sqrt(aspect) lands exactly on .5, which aspect=(1024.5/1024)**2 does: Python returns 1024 where Math.round returns 1025. The port deliberately uses Math.round and accepts that divergence (see sizing.ts), so NO GOLDEN CASE AT A TIE IS EMITTED HERE -- such a case would fail by design. CANVAS_ASPECT is 1.0 and has no runtime UI, so no tie is currently reachable.

blur._note: blur_schedule(prefs) -> (samples, stride). `samples` is the count that will ACTUALLY occur, which is what 1/N must be computed from.
